general-settings-dialog.enable-marking-mode-info: Ki te whakahohea te Aratau Tohu, ka taea e koe te kowhiri i nga mea ma te toia te kiore ki runga.
general-settings-dialog.enable-turbo-mode-info: Ki te whakahohea te Aratau Turbo, ka taea e koe te mahi tohu i te wa e pupuri ana koe i te taviri whakarereke penei i te Shift, Ctrl ranei.
general-settings-dialog.middle-mouse-button-behavior-info: Ma tenei ka whakatau he aha te mea ka pehia te paatene kiore waenga i te wa e whakaatuhia ana he tahua.
general-settings-dialog.move-pointer-to-menu-center: Nuku te atatohu ki te pokapū tahua
general-settings-dialog.move-pointer-to-menu-center-info: Ki te takina, ka nukuhia te atatohu kiore ki waenganui o te tahua, tahuaroto ranei ina tika. Ka penei pea mena ka whakatuwherahia he tahua kia tata rawa ki te taha o te mata, ki te whakatuwherahia ranei he tahua i roto i te Aratau Tauwaenga.
general-settings-dialog.require-click-for-hover-mode: Me paatoo mo nga whiringa Aratau Whakaparo
general-settings-dialog.require-click-for-hover-mode-info: Ki te kore e takina, ka kowhiria nga taonga ina nukuhia te kiore ki runga mo nga tahua ma te whakamahi i te Aratau Whakaparo.
general-settings-dialog.right-mouse-button-behavior-info: Ma tenei ka whakatau he aha te mea ka pehia te paatene kiore matau i te wa e whakaatuhia ana he tahua.
general-settings-dialog.select-parent: Whakatere ki runga kotahi te taumata
general-settings-dialog.trigger-center-click-on-key-release: Katia te tahua i runga i te tuku pokatata ki te pokapū
general-settings-dialog.trigger-center-click-on-key-release-info: Ma tenei ka puta te rerengamahi-a-waenga ka tukuna he taviri i te wa e whakapaoho ana ki te pokapu o te tahua.

settings.shortcut-info: Ma tenei pokatata e whakatuwhera te tahua. Kia kotahi te kī pūnoa me te maha o ngā whakakē pērā i Ctrl, Alt, Shift rānei. I te wa e tuhi ana, kaore koe e pehi i nga taviri katoa i te wa kotahi, ka taea hoki e koe te pehi tetahi i muri i tetahi. Ka whai hua tenei mena kua herea te pokatata ki tetahi atu tahua!
settings.window-condition: Tepe ki nga Taitara Matapihi Tauwhāiti
settings.anchored-mode-info: Whakatuwherahia nga tahuaroto ki te tuunga rite ki te tahua matua. Ma te tirotiro i tenei, ka whakakorehia te Aratau Tohu me te Aratau Turbo.
settings.fixed-position-mode-info: Whakatuwherahia te tahua ki te waahi kua whakaritea i runga i te mata, kaua ki te pehu.

settings.hover-mode-info: Mo nga kaiwhakamahi hiko anake! Tīpakohia ngā tūemi mā te whakaparo ki runga.
